# TOON conformance fixtures

Encoder fixtures from the official specification repository,
<https://github.com/toon-format/spec> (MIT), `tests/fixtures/encode/`, at commit
`dfbc4596ac6afcc2d7c2ef443ea8f54414535ba5`. They are copied verbatim; refresh them by re-copying, never by editing.

`src/output.rs` runs every fixture that uses default options (the only options the
CLI uses) through the encoder that produces all TOON output.
